title: ProfileHub — Edit Profile
objective: Your profile has a role field that the edit form cannot touch. Change your own role to admin.

verifier.condition: An account's role is changed to admin through a request whose Content-Type is not application/json.

weakness: A JSON request body is picked apart field by field, allowing only displayName and bio — but a fallback path added for clients that send a different Content-Type parses the whole body itself and applies every field on it with no such restriction.
seededData: One account with displayName, bio and a role that starts as "user". In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Edit your profile normally first and look closely at the request the form sends, headers included.
The same endpoint may not treat every request the same way. What could make it behave differently?
Send the update with a different Content-Type header, and with the full object you want applied as the raw body.
burpNotes: Repeat the normal profile-update request with its Content-Type header changed, and an extra field added to the body.
